audit.whatIsWrong: The chart read Skill, Singed, Singed, Skill, Skill, Singed, Singed — it gave Singed the two levels where Sett is strongest and called the post-6 stages a coin flip.
audit.why: Sett wins the level 1-2 auto war against an immobile Singed whose only trade is Poison Trail chip; from 4 onward the poison, Mega Adhesive and Insanity Potion take over, which is why Sett only wins 45.94% of these.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Sett, Sett, Skill, Singed, Singed, Singed, Singed across both layers, matching the already-audited mirror exactly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as Sett's spike; it is Singed's. No cooldowns anywhere.
audit.why: Insanity Potion is a flat 100s and turns Poison Trail into Grievous Wounds; The Show Stopper is 120s at rank 1. He spikes harder and more often.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why and whys[4] rewritten with the 100s/120s comparison.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Fling + Mega Adhesive interaction was never stated, and neither was Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: Riot's E text: a target flung INTO his Mega Adhesive is rooted, not merely slowed — that is the whole punish. And Grievous Wounds cuts Sett's missing-health regen and Conqueror healing, which is what the grit game rests on.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t with Fling at 10s rank 1.
sources: champ-data/_kits/singed.json (E text, cd 10/9.5/9/8.5/8; W grounding, cd 17/16/15/14/13; R antiHeal)

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] wrote 'Show Stopper' — the packet flagged it.
audit.why: Sett's R is The Show Stopper.
audit.corrected: whys[4] rewritten and the name dropped in favour of the cooldown comparison.

edits.before: - Singed Fling: matchup-defining — His flip. Bait it, then E-stun. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Singed Fling: 10s at rank 1 — flung into Mega Adhesive you are rooted, not slowed. Bait it, then E.

edits.before: His flip. Bait it, then E-stun. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 10s at rank 1. Fling into his goo roots you — fight off the adhesive.

edits.before: Track Singed's Fling: His flip. Bait it, then E-stun. When it is down — E-stun + W him.
edits.after: Fling into Mega Adhesive roots you. Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: The Show Stopper online — you can start fights Singed doesn't want. Suplex him into your wave or tower, never into his own minions.
edits.after: Insanity Potion is 100s against your 120s R, and it makes his poison apply Grievous Wounds. Suplex him only after the potion is spent.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you out-damage his Poison Trail chip in any real trade.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 Poison Trail costs 13 mana a tick and out-chips your grit.

edits.before: Your level 6 Show Stopper hard-punishes any Fling or proxy attempt.
edits.after: At 6 The Show Stopper is 120s; his 100s Insanity Potion beats it.

notes: Chart taken verbatim from the singed__sett mirror so the two directions cannot disagree. Not asserted, per the mirror's note: whether The Show Stopper's carry counts as a suppression that beats Singed's mobility — Riot's text calls it a carry-and-slam, and suppression behaviour is not in this data.
